verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a skills platform, for example acting on many skills or many items at once, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no Skills capability for bulk operations across many items. Plugin bundles, the single disableBundledSkills toggle, the 20-skills-per-request limit and Claude Code subagents or agent teams are adjacent features or host-platform features rather than a documented bulk-operation capability.
